after.tests/test_notices.py:
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import build_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")

# ---
def mark(when, status, owner="s1"):
    return Mark(owner, date(2026, 9, when), status)

MIXED = [
    mark(9, "absent"),
    mark(4, "absent"),
    mark(5, "present"),
    mark(6, "excused"),
]
EXPECTED = (
    "Ada Lovelace missed 2 days:\n"
    "- 2026-09-04\n"
    "- 2026-09-09"
)

class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_dates_in_order(self):
        text = build_notice(PUPIL, MIXED)
        self.assertEqual(text, EXPECTED)

    def test_single_day(self):
        text = build_notice(PUPIL, [mark(4, "absent")])
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day:", text)

    def test_foreign_mark(self):
        marks = [mark(4, "absent"), mark(5, "absent", "s2")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        marks = [mark(4, "present"), mark(5, "excused")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_marks(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, [])
